mentions.name: go-tachicrypt
mentions.description: A simple CLI tool that encrypts files or directories into multiple encrypted files, so the pieces can be split over multiple storages or sent via multiple channels. Started as a fun experiment; the author plans to harden it further and provide basic support.
mentions.source_excerpt:
1. go-tachicrypt ( https://github.com/voodooEntity/go-tachicrypt )
It started as a fun project/experiment - a very simple CLI tool which allows to encrypt file(s) / directory(ies) into multiple encrypted files so you can split them over multiple storages or send them via multiple channels.
